user_prompt: I need to pull together both our internal capability analysis to see if we're adequately staffed for the upcoming changes we're planning, and simultaneously check our procurement records to ensure all our vendor relationships maintain proper safety standings before we move forward with any new initiatives.

steps.step_name: Pull together our internal capability analysis to see if we're adequately staffed for the upcoming changes we're planning

args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 (READ payroll/compensation data). KEY AGENT: SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1 for workforce capability assessment
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (INBOUND REST API for goods receipt), Procurement agents (ProcurementMatchingAgent), OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine, AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator
- sap.crm: CRM - sales/marketing agents ONLY - NO performance analytics APIs
- sap.ehs: Safety/health - AGENTS ONLY - NO REST API for reading safety metrics
- sap.ariba: Procurement - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI (REST API for PO status + vendor monitoring), VendorInvoiceReconciliation
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY - NO create API for maintenance submission
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents only
- my.mes: Manufacturing - EquipmentOEEAnalytics, ProductionQualityMonitor
- siemens.plm: PLM - SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator, EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning, BOMComplianceValidator
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

INTERNAL CAPABILITY ANALYSIS:
- sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1 = PRIMARY for workforce capability assessment
  - Capabilities: monitor employee competencies, evaluate against project/change requirements, identify capability gaps, recommend development/reassignment
  - Supports dynamic workforce planning for organizational changes
  - Facilitates staffing adequacy assessment for upcoming initiatives

args.reason: This agent automates workforce capability assessment against project/change requirements, identifies gaps, and recommends staffing actions—directly fulfilling the internal capability analysis and staffing adequacy evaluation for upcoming changes.

method_trace.picked_reason: This agent automates workforce capability assessment against project/change requirements, identifies gaps, and recommends staffing actions—directly fulfilling the internal capability analysis and staffing adequacy evaluation for upcoming changes.
